lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the most anterior-dorsal grouping shows higher spatial density compared to the more sparse, larger centroids located mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-reflectance pixels on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in its lower-half surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct high-reflectance elongated object, consistent with a remora, is visible on the ventral midline beneath the pelvic region; high-contrast spotting is also visible on the ventral lobe of the caudal fin.
